name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) Hand-Spun Strawberry Cheesecake Shake
whyItWorks: Extremely rich shake with heavy dairy lactose, high sugar, and tiny strawberry seeds. Seeds and heavy cold cream provoke intense bowel spasms during active IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during flares. In remission, share a small cup with a friend and take a lactase enzyme tablet.
watchOuts: Contains whole strawberry seeds that irritate inflamed mucosal tissue
